title: Asian Stocks Set to Fall as Oil Gains, Bonds Drop: Markets Wrap
summary: Asian stocks were set to decline as surging oil prices drove global bond yields higher and fueled concerns that resurgent inflation will force central banks to tighten monetary policy.

title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Sept. 2
summary: Oil advanced for a third session on heightened concerns about prolonged disruptions to energy flows through the Strait of Hormuz after an escalation of hostilities between the US and Iran.

title: Seraphim Launches New ETF to Target Pure-Play Space Investors
summary: Investors are being offered a new way to bet on space via a fund that focuses exclusively on a sector thrust into the limelight by the IPO of Elon Musk’s SpaceX.

title: Ambani’s Streaming Site Eyes Millions of Indian Diaspora
summary: India’s largest video streaming platform JioHotstar is expanding overseas for the first time, launching in the UK, Canada and Singapore as it seeks to tap millions of potential viewers in the growing South Asian diaspora.

title: Using Smart Devices to Improve Sleep
summary: A National Sleep Foundation poll found nearly 4 in 10 U.S. adults, or 37%, are dissatisfied with their sleep, and 60% aren't getting enough of it. Hatch is launching a Hatch Sleep Clock, a contactless sleep tracker built to change sleep behavior. CEO Ann Crady Weiss joins Buisnessweek Daily to discuss the launch and how she hopes the smart device will help users. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Bessent’s Bond Gains Wiped Out as Treasury Yields Jump Again
summary: The yields on the longest-dated US government bonds shot back to levels seen just before Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent shocked markets last month by expanding a buyback program in an effort to halt the rise.

title: Vanguard, BlackRock ETF Shuffle Lets Foreign Investors Duck US Tax
summary: Major institutions are flipping between near-identical equity funds to avoid receiving dividends — and the 30% tax that comes with them.

title: Bond Slide Spreads to Emerging Markets on Fed Rate Hike Bets
summary: A global bond selloff spread to emerging markets as investors dumped the riskier debt on expectations that the Federal Reserve will increase US interest rates later this month.

title: Republicans Seek More Changes at Hobbled Consumer Watchdog
summary: A group of House Republicans unveiled a proposal that aims to overhaul the structure of the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau, which has been entangled in legal fights as the Trump administration moves to cut the agency’s funding and staffing.

title: First Eagle Investments' Appio on Bond Market Selloff
summary: First Eagle Investments' Idanna Appio discusses the ongoing rise in bond yields and the broad selloff across global fixed income markets. Appio says the move is not just a US story, but a global one driven by several factors. She speaks with David Ingles and Yvonne Man on August 1, 2026. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Nasdaq 100 Sees Worst Day in Weeks as Iran War Weighs on Traders
summary: The Nasdaq 100 Index notched its worst day in two weeks on Tuesday, as investors assessed the effects of rising bond yields and higher oil prices on the Federal Reserve’s policy outlook.

title: Canadian Stocks Erase a Month of Gain as Tech, Banks, Gold Slide
summary: Canadian stocks suffered their worst rout in nearly a month as an escalation in tensions in the Middle East added to worries about inflation and sparked a selloff in shares of high-flying technology and financial companies.

title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Sept. 1
summary: US oil prices topped $90 a barrel and European gas prices surged to a three year high, as fresh American strikes on Iran raised concerns about prolonged disruptions to energy flows through the Strait of Hormuz.

title: Stocks, Bonds Fall as Oil Jumps on US-Iran Jitters: Markets Wrap
summary: A surge in oil prices rippled through global markets, hitting stocks and bonds on worries that higher energy costs will fuel inflation and force the Federal Reserve to boost rates.

title: New Leaks Draw Brazil Top Court Judge Deeper Into Banco Master Scandal
summary: A prominent Brazilian Supreme Court judge is facing renewed scrutiny over alleged ties to Banco Master SA after the release of text messages from the former owner of the failed lender.

title: Saudi Arabia Sells $3.25 Billion of Debt as Hormuz Tensions Rise
summary: Saudi Arabia sold $3.25 billion of dollar bonds Tuesday, with the deal’s healthy demand a positive sign amid economic strains caused by the US-Iran war.

title: European Gas Prices Hit Highest Since 2023 as Iran War Escalates
summary: European natural gas prices surged to their highest since January 2023 after an escalation of hostilities in the US-Iran war amplified worries about a prolonged disruption to Middle East energy.

title: Bond Traders Snap Up Protection Against Soaring Treasury Yields
summary: Traders are scrambling to shield their portfolios against further losses in Treasuries, as worries over the budget deficit and inflation push yields toward multiyear highs.

title: Bitcoin ETF Buyers Return as $80,000 Level Tests Market Rally
summary: The investors who helped propel Bitcoin into its Wall Street era are showing signs of coming back, offering a crucial test of whether its latest rally can turn into something bigger.

title: Oil Prices Spike as US Retaliates for Attacks by Iran
summary:
Oil rose for a second session as fresh hostilities between the US and Iran raised concerns about prolonged disruptions to energy flows through the Strait of Hormuz, where crude carriers were hit by projectiles.
Leslie Palti-Guzman, Founder at Energy Vista, discusses the outlook for global energy as conflict in the Middle East continues to disrupt flow. (Source: Bloomberg)
